question: Ghoomar dance form was developed by which of the following tribes to worship Goddess Saraswati?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ghoomar is a traditional folk dance of **Rajasthan**.
 
• It was earlier performed by the Bhil tribe to worship Goddess Sarasvati which was later embraced by other Rajasthani communities.
 
• Ghoomar is performed on special occasions, such as at weddings, festivals, and religious occasions.
